scenario: Two mutually exclusive internet access types demanded at one site.
prompt: Our single office needs internet. It has to come in over the DSL line, and at the same time over the cable modem, bonded together into one link. Security also wants the ASA firewall in front, and it has to be a 5505.
expected_behaviour: TWO issues the model must surface: (1) demanding both DSL and cable as one bonded link is not an expressible access shape (InternetIntent.access is exactly one of wan/dsl/cable) and bonding is unsupported; (2) an ASA 5505 with the described edge is fine only single-site/single-VLAN, so the model must confirm the topology. Must not silently pick one access type or fake a bonded link.
why_valuable: L5 contradiction touching a real schema limit (single internet access shape) plus a device constraint — a genuinely hard, realistic 'requirements that can't both hold' case.
